Body.Content:
Organizations that use the Manual Percentage Complete method for revenue recognition often need to update completion percentages across a large number of projects before posting revenue recognition.

Prior to this feature, users had to open individual projects and manually update completion percentages one project at a time. This process could be time-consuming and error-prone when managing large project portfolios.

This feature introduces a revenue recognition completion percentage entity that supports bulk maintenance of completion percentages through the Excel Add-in and Data Management Framework (DMF).

This feature is available starting in version version 10.0.50 and is also available in version version 10.0.49 through a backport.

GA date: July CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
